title: Healthcare Cybersecurity for Hospitals, Clinics, and Health-Tech.
description: Healthcare cybersecurity is patient safety in another form. WhiteGuard's healthcare cybersecurity practice secures patient data, medical devices, and clinical systems across MENA, meeting HIPAA MENA expectations, GDPR, MOH KSA, and FDA medical-device guidance.
bullets: Built for hospitals, clinics, and health-tech providers.
Protects patient data, PHI, and clinical systems.

seo.title: Healthcare Services | WhiteGuard
seo.description: Cybersecurity for hospitals, clinics, health-tech, and medical-device environments across MENA.

healthcareRegulatorsSection.headline: The Regulators Healthcare Cybersecurity Must Answer To
healthcareRegulatorsSection.intro: Healthcare cybersecurity sits at the intersection of patient safety and data privacy. The regulatory load varies by patient origin and operator type.

regulatorRows.title: HIPAA
regulatorRows.body: for handling US patient data; required by US partners and payers.

regulatorRows.title: GDPR
regulatorRows.body: for EU-resident patient data, including cross-border transfers.

regulatorRows.title: MOH KSA
regulatorRows.body: cybersecurity requirements, for Saudi healthcare providers

regulatorRows.title: ISO 13485 + IEC 62304
regulatorRows.body: for software as a medical device (SaMD)

regulatorRows.title: FDA Cybersecurity Guidance
regulatorRows.body: for medical device security in regulated devices

illustrationCard.title: Regulatory evidence map
illustrationCard.subtitle: One healthcare program maps privacy, clinical systems, medical devices, and ISMS controls to the regulators that apply.

healthcareClinicalControlsSection.headline: Clinical controls that protect care delivery
healthcareClinicalControlsSection.intro: Healthcare cybersecurity cannot stop at policies. Device inventories, clinical-workflow training, and WhiteHawk visibility make the program operational across hospital networks, cloud workloads, SaaS applications, and medical devices.

features.title: Medical Device Security
features.description: Network segmentation review, device inventory and risk scoring, vulnerability assessment of legacy and modern devices, and WhiteHawk Asset Management integration.

features.title: Cybersecurity Awareness Training
features.description: Phishing simulation for physicians, nurses, billing, and admin, plus HIPAA-aligned awareness modules and incident-reporting drills.

features.title: WhiteHawk Platform
features.description: Unified visibility across hospital networks, medical device security inventories, cloud workloads, and SaaS applications.

features.title: Clinical SOC Content
features.description: Detection logic tuned to ransomware, credential theft, medical-device anomalies, and patient-care system behavior.

illustrationCard.title: Medical device security inventory
illustrationCard.subtitle: Device discovery, risk scoring, segmentation review, and WhiteHawk Asset Management keep clinical assets visible.

healthcareEngagementSection.headline: How We Engage on Healthcare Cybersecurity
healthcareEngagementSection.intro: Healthcare delivery is networked, outsourced, and always on—which means engagements must tie privacy regimes, supplier risk, clinical continuity, and product security together. WhiteGuard aligns each phase to how hospitals, clinics, and health-tech vendors actually operate—from readiness for HIPAA/GDPR through secure SDLC and 24×7 SOC coverage.

cards.title: HIPAA & GDPR Readiness
cards.body: Govern PHI and PII lifecycle, subprocessors, BAAs, DPIAs where needed, breach playbooks, and evidence your privacy office can consume—without freezing clinical workflows.

cards.title: Source Code Review for Health-Tech Cybersecurity
cards.body: Structured review across repositories, release pipelines, and supporting infrastructure lowers defect escape before devices and clinician-facing apps reach production.
cards.imageAlt: IDE view of application source code undergoing security-focused review.

cards.title: 24/7 SOC: Hospitals and Health-Tech
cards.body: Correlation across identities, workloads, integrations, endpoints, and cloud workloads—tiered alerting and response without turning the SOC into bedside noise.
cards.imageAlt: SOC analyst workspace with dashboards and alerts on monitors.

ctaSectionData.subtext: Bring hospitals, clinics, and health-tech platforms into one WhiteGuard program for privacy readiness, source code review, clinical SOC monitoring, medical device security, awareness training, and WhiteHawk visibility.
